name: Flora
source:
Role: I'm not really sure what she does...
[Spoiler]Flora is... frustrating. Later today, I am to begin teaching her how to draw. I'm not sure I can... I've never taught anyone anything so directly; I'm more adept at offering spiritual advice.[/spoiler] She doesn't seem to take her faith seriously, which concerns me.

[Edited from the in-game description]
